info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Epidotex Racket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Epidotex Racket Detail Management API allows users to manage detailed entries for the Epidotex racket catalog. This API endpoint facilitates the addition of new product specifications, enabling businesses to enhance their product offerings with accurate and detailed information. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems that require up-to-date racket details for operational efficiency. Developers can leverage this endpoint to streamline the catalog creation process, ensuring that the information presented to customers is thorough and reliable.

post.summary: Create a new detail for the Epidotex racket.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail associated with the Epidotex racket. Ensure that all required fields are filled in the request body. Upon successful creation, the detail will be stored in the system, and an acknowledgment will be returned.
